data.title: Iranian Churn (2020), UCI
data.provider_facts: 3150 rows; first-nine-month attributes, end-month-12 churn; three-month planning gap; no usable per-row timestamps
data.public_data_policy: Code and aggregate metrics only; raw data, model files and row predictions remain local

method.title: scikit-learn 1.4.2 HistGradientBoostingClassifier
method.claim: Binary log-loss boosting; fixed iteration and leaf budget, binning learned within fit

metrics.use: AP, Brier and capacity metrics; independent tie-aware AP/squared-loss/count checks in executed code

novelty: Established method, new local refit experiment; not new paper or independent validation
authored_code_figures_licence: MIT; UCI-derived aggregate outputs retain CC BY 4.0 attribution
